description: Sign + verify workflow. sign_pdf auto-injects a /Sig placeholder when missing, so the prepare_signature_placeholder step is OPTIONAL (keep it only to customize the placeholder, e.g. larger placeholderBytes for >4096-bit RSA keys). PEM -> DER: `openssl x509 -in cert.pem -outform DER | base64 -w0` (cert) and `openssl pkey -in key.pem -outform DER | base64 -w0` (ECDSA key).

blocks.text: Both parties agree to the terms set out herein.

arguments.ecPrivateKeyDerBase64: <your EC private key in PKCS#8 DER, base64>

trustedRootsDerBase64: <optional self-signed root or CA in DER, base64>
